items.title: Ukraine: EU lists 113 individuals and entities to further restrict Russia’s ability to finance its war of aggression
items.summary: The Council has imposed restrictive measures on 12 individuals and 101 entities active in the banking, financial and energy sectors for their role in financing Russia’s war efforts and supporting its shadow fleet.

items.title: EU Global Human Rights Sanctions Regime: Council lists four Haitian entities over serious human rights violations
items.summary: The Council adopted restrictive measures against four Haitian criminal armed groups responsible for grave violations against children in armed conflict, including killings, sexual violence and the recruitment of children.

items.title: Russia’s FIMI and malicious cyber activities: Council imposes sanctions on 30 individuals and two entities
items.summary: The Council adopted restrictive measures against 30 individuals and one entity responsible for actions on behalf of the Russian Federation undermining and threatening democracy, stability or security in the EU and some of its Member States or in third countrie

items.title: Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad: EU adds one entity and its founder to the sanctions list
items.summary: The Council has added one individual and one entity to the sanctions list against Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, for their role in financing Hamas.

items.title: Ukraine Facility: Council approves largest-ever payment of €8 billion to Kyiv
items.summary: The Council approved a record payment of just under €8 billion for Ukraine under the Ukraine Facility, following Ukraine’s successful completion of over 20 target steps under the Ukraine Plan.

items.title: European Peace Facility: Council increases support for maritime security in the Gulf of Guinea to €31 million
items.summary: The Council increased financial support through the European Peace Facility (EPF) from €21 million to €31 million, benefitting military actors and navies of coastal states involved in maritime security operations in the Gulf of Guinea.
